title: Project Serpo exchange program
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Project Serpo exchange program, about 1970s (leak 2000s) at Earth and planet Serpo, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So the Serpo thing was planet Serpo sent a bunch of aliens here and we sent a bunch of humans to their star system in an exchange in the 1970s sometime.

plain: A researcher and writer, Greg Bishop, sums up the Serpo story, which came out through leaks in the 2000s and which he connects to a man named Rick Doty. As Bishop tells it, sometime in the 1970s a planet called Serpo sent a group of aliens to Earth, and the US sent a group of humans to the aliens' star system in exchange. If true, it would mean people have already lived on another world.
